summary.text: Tim Hicks is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 6, part of Washington County, who lives in Gray and has served since November 2020; he is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Hicks graduated from Daniel Boone High School in 1981 and owns Hicks Construction.
He has served as Northeast Tennessee area vice president of the Home Builders Association of Tennessee and on the Washington County Planning Commission from 2016 to 2020.
Hicks has been a member of the House since the 112th General Assembly and serves as Republican Caucus Vice-Chairman.
The House website lists him on the Education, Finance, Ways, and Means, and Health committees and the Fiscal Review Committee.
